Role_play_statement: We sometimes learn about missing delivery details only when Warehouse asks.
Finding: Validation responsibility and required fields need definition.

Role_play_statement: Customers cancel, but we cannot always tell whether the order has already shipped.
A shelf quantity is not a reliable promise if stock is already committed.
Finding: Availability and lead times must precede confirmation.

Role_play_statement: Dispatch paperwork and the recorded stock movement do not always happen together.
Finding: Keep physical and posting dates separate.

Role_play_statement: I ask several teams before I can explain a delay.
Finding: An order view and accountable exception owner are needed.

Role_play_statement: Some customers need part of an order urgently; others reject split shipments.
Finding: Record partial-delivery agreement; do not assume one rule for everyone.

Role_play_statement: Sales wants to release held orders, but Finance must own credit decisions.
We wait for dispatch emails before reviewing what should be billed.
Finding: Reconcile goods-issued deliveries with billing queue daily.

Role_play_statement: We need to explain price corrections without losing the first invoice.
A receipt can be short or lack a usable invoice reference.
Joining several document lists may duplicate values; custom screens need a clear purpose.
Finding: Agree grains, freshness and standard-first fit.
